html:
luiskr.com

luiskr.com / playground/earth-background / EarthBackground

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/earth-background.ts:62

Owns the full WebGPU/WebGL Earth scene: renderer, camera rig, sun+moon lighting, the textured Earth group (surface/clouds/atmosphere shells), and the TSL post-processing pipeline (bloom → chromatic aberration → color grade → vignette → film grain).
